$comment: Size ceilings (bytes) for built Studio bundles, checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.ts. Studio is a dev tool so end users don't download it, but it is unmonitored otherwise (the codecov bundle path is broken — see codecov-bundle-analysis-diagnosis.md). Raise a ceiling deliberately, with justification, when a real feature grows it.
$ratchet: studio.js measured 2859010 bytes on the monaco-0.56 build (2858942 before it), against a 14000000 ceiling set when Monaco was still inlined in the entry. Splitting moved Monaco into dist/chunks, so the old ceiling had stopped describing anything: it left 5x headroom and would not have caught a doubling. Lowered to just above the measured figure.
